name: What information do I need before getting a quote for shower removal?
description: Have photos, shower dimensions, damage details, and your replacement goal ready so the estimate is more accurate.

mainEntity.name: What information do I need before getting a quote for shower removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: You usually need a clear idea of the shower size, the current materials, and whether you want a replacement, a tub-to-shower conversion, or just demolition. Photos of the shower, any leak history, and notes about plumbing access help a contractor give a more accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have photos, shower dimensions, damage details, and your replacement goal ready so the estimate is more accurate.
